description: A custom Android ViewGroup layout class that arranges its child views in a grid with fixed cell sizes, handling measurement and layout of children based on specified cell width and height attributes.

classes.name: FixedGridLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that arranges its children in a grid with fixed cell dimensions, supporting dynamic row and column calculation at runtime.

methods.name: FixedGridLayout
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layout with context, optionally reading custom attributes for cell width and height.

methods.name: setCellWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of each cell and requests layout update.

methods.name: setCellHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of each cell and requests layout update.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures child views based on cell size and determines the overall size of the layout.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions child views within the grid based on calculated rows and columns.
